description: This file contains functions related to displaying and retrieving calendar activities, including fetching pending/upcoming activities and generating activity view selection HTML, likely used within a calendar or task management module of a CRM system.

classes.name: DateTimeField
classes.description: A class for handling date and time formatting and manipulation.

methods.name: getPendingActivities
methods.description: Retrieves a list of pending or upcoming activities based on the provided mode and view, returning an array with details for display.

methods.name: getActivityview
methods.description: Generates an HTML select element for choosing different activity views such as Today, This Week, etc.
